title: 互補式堆疊電晶體研究流程
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解上下互補層、中介隔離及分層接觸，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 互補堆疊架構
stages.description: 在「互補堆疊架構」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for complementary stacked architecture, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 垂直互補配置
steps.objective: 完成「垂直互補配置」的因果圖，把上下互補層、中介隔離及分層接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for draw vertical complementary stacking, connecting relevant limits in complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：垂直互補配置。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：CFET 堆疊 n 與 p 元件，不只是多片同極性通道。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Draw vertical complementary stacking. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: CFET stacks n and p devices, not merely multiple same-polarity channels. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「CFET 堆疊 n 與 p 元件，不只是多片同極性通道。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: CFET stacks n and p devices, not merely multiple same-polarity channels. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「垂直互補配置」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw vertical complementary stacking and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「垂直互補配置」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for draw vertical complementary stacking: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 垂直互補配置的原理
knowledge.text: CFET 堆疊 n 與 p 元件，不只是多片同極性通道。
knowledge.textEn: CFET stacks n and p devices, not merely multiple same-polarity channels.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: CFET 以垂直方向取代部分平面 n-p 間距，但其面積收益取決於可實現的接觸與標準元件佈線。
knowledge.textEn: CFET replaces some lateral n-p spacing vertically, but area benefits depend on realizable contacts and cell routing.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「互補式堆疊電晶體研究流程」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「垂直互補配置」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：上下堆疊縮面積可能增加熱、接觸與流程依賴。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「奈米元件整合：閘極到背面供電」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：互補式堆疊電晶體研究流程 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「上下堆疊縮面積可能增加熱、接觸與流程依賴」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Complementary FET research process flows as the task boundary. After reading “Draw vertical complementary stacking”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: Vertical stacking can trade area for thermal, contact and sequence constraints. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Device integration: gate stack to backside power”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Complementary FET research process flows: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “Vertical stacking can trade area for thermal, contact and sequence constraints” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 評估「垂直互補配置」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating draw vertical complementary stacking?
options: CFET 堆疊 n 與 p 元件，不只是多片同極性通道。
總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。
頂面膜厚代表所有側壁與底部厚度。
optionsEn: CFET stacks n and p devices, not merely multiple same-polarity channels.
Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact.
Top thickness represents all sidewall and bottom thicknesses.
quiz.explanation: CFET 堆疊 n 與 p 元件，不只是多片同極性通道。 CFET 以垂直方向取代部分平面 n-p 間距，但其面積收益取決於可實現的接觸與標準元件佈線。
quiz.explanationEn: CFET stacks n and p devices, not merely multiple same-polarity channels. CFET replaces some lateral n-p spacing vertically, but area benefits depend on realizable contacts and cell routing.

steps.title: 單體與順序整合
steps.objective: 完成「單體與順序整合」的對照表，把上下互補層、中介隔離及分層接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for compare monolithic and sequential integration, connecting relevant limits in complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：單體與順序整合。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：單次堆疊加工與先後形成元件有不同熱限制。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Compare monolithic and sequential integration. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Single-stack and sequential device formation have different thermal constraints. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「單次堆疊加工與先後形成元件有不同熱限制。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Single-stack and sequential device formation have different thermal constraints. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「單體與順序整合」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compare monolithic and sequential integration and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「單體與順序整合」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for compare monolithic and sequential integration: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.title: 標準元件高度
steps.objective: 完成「標準元件高度」的敏感度草圖，把上下互補層、中介隔離及分層接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for budget standard-cell height, connecting relevant limits in complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：標準元件高度。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：移除平面 n-p 間距不代表所有配線空間消失。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 畫平面互補元件與 CFET 兩個相同輸入輸出的反相器；在每圖標出上下或左右源汲極、閘、VDD、VSS 與輸出。用連通性而非外形證明功能一致。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Budget standard-cell height. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Removing lateral n-p separation does not eliminate routing space needs. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Draw planar and CFET inverters with identical inputs and outputs. Mark source-drain, gates, VDD, VSS and output on each. Establish equivalent function through connectivity rather than shape.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「移除平面 n-p 間距不代表所有配線空間消失。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Removing lateral n-p separation does not eliminate routing space needs. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「標準元件高度」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for budget standard-cell height and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「標準元件高度」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for budget standard-cell height: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

steps.title: 頂底通道分工
steps.objective: 完成「頂底通道分工」的故障判別表，把上下互補層、中介隔離及分層接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for assign top and bottom channels, connecting relevant limits in complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：頂底通道分工。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：兩層元件需要可辨識的電性及接觸測試。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assign top and bottom channels. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Both device tiers need distinguishable electrical and contact tests. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「兩層元件需要可辨識的電性及接觸測試。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Both device tiers need distinguishable electrical and contact tests. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assign top and bottom channels and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「頂底通道分工」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for assign top and bottom channels: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：共同閘選項。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：共享閘連接仍需設定兩種元件的閾值。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess common-gate options. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Common gate connectivity still needs separate threshold setting for both polarities. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「共享閘連接仍需設定兩種元件的閾值。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for assess common-gate options: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：垂直節距。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：更小垂直距離會加劇隔離與加工空間限制。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Budget vertical pitch. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Smaller vertical spacing tightens isolation and processing constraints. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「更小垂直距離會加劇隔離與加工空間限制。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for budget vertical pitch and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「垂直節距」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for budget vertical pitch: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

knowledge.title: 垂直節距的原理
knowledge.text: 更小垂直距離會加劇隔離與加工空間限制。
knowledge.textEn: Smaller vertical spacing tightens isolation and processing constraints.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: CFET 以垂直方向取代部分平面 n-p 間距，但其面積收益取決於可實現的接觸與標準元件佈線。
knowledge.textEn: CFET replaces some lateral n-p spacing vertically, but area benefits depend on realizable contacts and cell routing.

quiz.question: 評估「垂直節距」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating budget vertical pitch?
options: 總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。
頂面膜厚代表所有側壁與底部厚度。
更小垂直距離會加劇隔離與加工空間限制。
optionsEn: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact.
Top thickness represents all sidewall and bottom thicknesses.
Smaller vertical spacing tightens isolation and processing constraints.

quiz.explanationEn: Smaller vertical spacing tightens isolation and processing constraints. CFET replaces some lateral n-p spacing vertically, but area benefits depend on realizable contacts and cell routing.
